dialogue.origin: (本日は宜しくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (I look forward to working with you today.)

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. I look forward to it.)

dialogue.origin: （扱いたいテーマがありましたら、遠慮なくおっしゃってください）
dialogue.content: (If there’s a topic you’d like to address, please feel free to let me know.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございます。お任せいたします）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I'll leave it up to you.)

dialogue.origin: （承知しました）
dialogue.content: (Understood.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは初めに年齢、性別、今日お話ししたい事を教えて下さい
dialogue.content: Good evening. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about today?
13 years old.

dialogue.origin: 男
dialogue.content: Male.

dialogue.origin: 死にたい
dialogue.content: I want to die.

dialogue.origin: 生きている意味がわからない
dialogue.content: I don't see the point in living.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとうそんな風に思っているんですね辛いですね
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me. So that's how you're feeling. That must be so painful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 中学生ですか？
dialogue.content: Are you in middle school?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんな時そんな風に感じますか
dialogue.content: When do you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: ずっと
dialogue.content: All the time.

dialogue.origin: 生きててもしかたない
dialogue.content: There’s no point in being alive.

dialogue.origin: ずっとなんですねうんうん、しかたないっておもうんですね
dialogue.content: Always, I see. Mm-hmm, so you feel like there's no point.

dialogue.origin: いつごろからそう思いようになりましたか
dialogue.content: When did you start feeling that way?

dialogue.origin: 寝ててこのまま死ねたら楽慣れるのに
dialogue.content: It would be a relief if I could just die in my sleep.

dialogue.origin: 中学1年終わりぐらい
dialogue.content: Around the end of my first year of middle school.

dialogue.origin: もういいよね
dialogue.content: I've had enough, right?

dialogue.origin: 楽になりたいんですねそのくらいしんどい思いでいきているんですね
dialogue.content: You want to find relief. You're living with that much pain.

dialogue.origin: 中一のとき、そんな気持ちになったのはきっかけはありましたか
dialogue.content: Back in your first year of middle school, was there any trigger for feeling that way?

dialogue.origin: しんどい
dialogue.content: It's painful.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、すこし一緒にどうしたらいいいか考えたいです
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I'd like for us to think together for a bit about what we can do.

dialogue.origin: いろいろあってよくわからない
dialogue.content: A lot of things happened, and I don't really know.

dialogue.origin: いろいろありすぎたのね、、、それは例えば学校のことですかおうちの事とかですか
dialogue.content: There have been so many things, huh... For example, was it about school? Or things at home?

dialogue.origin: 両方かな
dialogue.content: Both, I guess.

dialogue.origin: そうそれは考えるだけで疲れてしまうんだと思います今日まで悩んできたんですね
dialogue.content: I imagine it's exhausting just to think about it. You've been struggling with this all this time, haven't you?

dialogue.origin: 家も学校もどこにも居場所がない
dialogue.content: I don’t have a place where I belong, not at home and not at school.

dialogue.origin: 誰もわかってくれない
dialogue.content: No one understands me.

dialogue.origin: 詳しく話せる？話せるところだけでいいですよ
dialogue.content: Can you talk about it in more detail? You only have to share what you feel comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: しんどいから無理
dialogue.content: It's too painful, so I can't.

dialogue.origin: うんうん今はしんどいんですね大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it's painful right now, isn't it? That's okay.

dialogue.origin: 生まれてこないほうが良かったんだ
dialogue.content: It would have been better if I hadn’t been born.

dialogue.origin: 僕が死んだ方がみんなに迷惑かけずに済む
dialogue.content: If I died, I wouldn't be a bother to everyone.

dialogue.origin: これ以上生きてたらダメだと思う
dialogue.content: I don't think I should live any longer.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に思うことがあったんですね迷惑をかけていると感じるの？
dialogue.content: So there have been things that made you feel that way. Do you feel like you're a bother to people?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それがいやなんですね、、他にはなにか思っていることはありますか
dialogue.content: And you don't like that... Is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 僕が生きていたら周りを嫌な気持ちにさせてしまうから
dialogue.content: Because if I'm alive, I make the people around me feel bad.

dialogue.origin: だからいない方がいい
dialogue.content: So it's better if I'm not here.

dialogue.origin: 死んだ方がいい
dialogue.content: It's better if I die.

dialogue.origin: 周りとは例えば誰の事をを考えていますか
dialogue.content: When you say 'the people around you,' who are you thinking of, for example?

dialogue.origin: 親や友達
dialogue.content: My parents and friends.

dialogue.origin: 親はお父さん、お母さんどっちかな
dialogue.content: When you say parents, do you mean your dad and your mom?

dialogue.origin: 両方
dialogue.content: Both.

dialogue.origin: うんうんご両親、お友達に嫌な思いをさせたくないんですね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. So you don't want to make your parents and friends feel bad, do you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 優しい気持ちをもっているんですね
dialogue.content: You have such a kind heart.

dialogue.origin: 僕が生きているだけで、嫌な思いをさせている
dialogue.content: Just by being alive, I'm making them feel bad.

dialogue.origin: べつに優しくないよ
dialogue.content: I’m not kind at all.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に思うのはどうしてですか
dialogue.content: Why do you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 言われたから
dialogue.content: Because that's what I was told.

dialogue.origin: 言われたのね、、悲しかったですね、、
dialogue.content: You were told that... That must have been so sad...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: そんなこと言われたら誰だって辛くて色々考えてしまいますよね今日まで我慢してきたんですね
dialogue.content: Anyone would feel hurt and overthink things if they were told something like that. You've been enduring it all this time, haven't you?

dialogue.origin: 我慢？分からない
dialogue.content: Enduring? I don't know.

dialogue.origin: もう生きてる意味がないから
dialogue.content: Because there's no meaning to my life anymore.

dialogue.origin: 早く死にたい
dialogue.content: I want to die soon.

dialogue.origin: どうしたら死ねますか？
dialogue.content: How can I die?

dialogue.origin: ネットで検索したけど、悩む
dialogue.content: I searched online, but I'm hesitant.

dialogue.origin: 死なない方法もあると思いますよ
dialogue.content: I believe there are other ways, besides dying.

dialogue.origin: 死にたいから
dialogue.content: But I want to die.

dialogue.origin: 楽になりたいんですよね
dialogue.content: You want to find relief, don’t you?

dialogue.origin: 楽？というより、死なないといけない
dialogue.content: Relief? It’s more like I have to die.

dialogue.origin: だって、周りが嫌な思いをしてるから
dialogue.content: Because I’m making the people around me feel bad.

dialogue.origin: 生きていたらダメなんです
dialogue.content: I'm not allowed to be alive.

dialogue.origin: いけないの？死ぬしか嫌な思いしなくなる方法はないということはないですよ
dialogue.content: You're not allowed? Dying isn't the only way to stop them from feeling bad.

dialogue.origin: 存在自体がダメだから
dialogue.content: Because my very existence is wrong.

dialogue.origin: いなくなればいいのにって
dialogue.content: 'I wish you would just disappear.'

dialogue.origin: そういわれたのね誰に言われたかは聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: That's what you were told. May I ask who said that to you?

dialogue.origin: 友達
dialogue.content: A friend.

dialogue.origin: 産むんじゃなかったって
dialogue.content: 'I wish I'd never had you.'

dialogue.origin: お母さんから
dialogue.content: From my mom.

dialogue.origin: どうして、、？
dialogue.content: Why...?

dialogue.origin: 分からない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: 僕のせいでお母さんいなくなったんだって、頼むから消えてくれって
dialogue.content: 'Mom is gone because of you, so please, just disappear.'

dialogue.origin: お父さんに言われた
dialogue.content: My dad told me that.

dialogue.origin: どうしてあなたのせいなんでしょう、、お父さんは間違っているかもしれないですよ
dialogue.content: Why would it be your fault? Your father might be wrong.

dialogue.origin: お母さんがいなくなったんですね寂しかったでしょう
dialogue.content: Your mom is gone, isn't she? You must have been lonely.

dialogue.origin: そうだと思う
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: お父さんはそうだね
dialogue.content: My dad was, yes.

dialogue.origin: そうとは、、、間違っているとおもう？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'I think so'... Do you think he's wrong?

dialogue.origin: お父さんはさみしかったと思うけど、ぼくはよくわからない
dialogue.content: I think my dad was lonely, but I’m not really sure about myself.

dialogue.origin: あなたの気持ちのことでしたね、、わからなかったのね
dialogue.content: Oh, I see, we were talking about your feelings. You weren't sure what you felt.

dialogue.origin: お母さんのイメージははどんな感じですか
dialogue.content: What kind of image do you have of your mom?

dialogue.origin: かわいそうな人
dialogue.content: A pitiable person.

dialogue.origin: どういうところでしょう
dialogue.content: In what way?

dialogue.origin: わからない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: なんとなく
dialogue.content: It's just a feeling.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね幸せそうではなかったということでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. Does that mean she didn't seem happy?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、おかあさんはどうなっていけばいいなと思っていますか
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, what do you hope for your mother?

dialogue.origin: わからない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 生きていたらいけない存在なんです
dialogue.content: I’m someone who shouldn’t be alive.

dialogue.origin: 生まれたらいけない存在なんです
dialogue.content: I’m someone who shouldn’t have been born.

dialogue.origin: お父さんとお友達に言われたから？
dialogue.content: Because your dad and your friend said so?

dialogue.origin: みんなに言われたから
dialogue.content: Because everyone told me so.

dialogue.origin: 他にもいるの？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone else?

dialogue.origin: 両親と友達から
dialogue.content: From my parents and friends.

dialogue.origin: お母さん？
dialogue.content: Your mother, too?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうとても悲しかったと思います、、
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been very sad...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どうしてそんなこと言ったのかはわからない？
dialogue.content: You don’t know why they said those things?

dialogue.origin: わからないです
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: きっと僕が何かしたんだと思います
dialogue.content: I'm sure I must have done something.

dialogue.origin: 死にたくなってしまう気持ちがわかりました心が苦しくて疲れてしまったんだと感じましたここまでお話を聞いて、、、
dialogue.content: After listening to what you've shared, I can understand why you feel you want to die. It sounds like you are in agony and completely exhausted...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんはとても何か苦しんでいたのかもしれないと思います。お父さんはそれをあなたのせいにしたいと思っているだけかもしれません
dialogue.content: I think your mother might have been suffering a great deal from something. And perhaps your father just wants to put the blame on you.

dialogue.origin: しんどいのはもうあんまりないよただ死にたいと思うだけ
dialogue.content: The pain isn't really there anymore. I just want to die.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないし、そうじゃないかもしれない考えるのもやめた
dialogue.content: Maybe so, maybe not. I've stopped thinking about it.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか疲れたね
dialogue.content: I see, I see. You're tired, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, I am.

dialogue.origin: でももう少し生きてみませんか何かが変ることもあるんですよ
dialogue.content: But would you consider living just a little longer? Sometimes things can change, you know.

dialogue.origin: よくわからない
dialogue.content: I don't really understand.

dialogue.origin: 考え方がかわったり、生きてみたくなったりいま、とても疲れている中で決めてほしくないなと思います
dialogue.content: Your perspective might change, or you might start to want to live. I wouldn't want you to make this decision while you're so exhausted.

dialogue.origin: 生きているだけでダメな存在だから
dialogue.content: Because I'm a worthless person just for being alive.

dialogue.origin: 嫌な思いをさせる
dialogue.content: I make people feel bad.

dialogue.origin: あなたにも迷惑をかけた
dialogue.content: I've bothered you, too.

dialogue.origin: 聴いてくれてありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening.

dialogue.origin: 存在がだめなんて、そんなことないですよ私に？私は色々話してくれて、あなたに生きてほしいとおもいましたよ
dialogue.content: It's not true that your existence is worthless. A bother to me? Hearing you share all this with me made me want you to live.

dialogue.origin: 優しくないと言っていたけど私はそう感じました
dialogue.content: You said you weren't kind, but I felt that you are.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ
dialogue.content: Oh, really?

dialogue.origin: 嫌な事をいってきた人が正しいわけではないですよ
dialogue.content: The people who said those awful things to you are not necessarily right.

dialogue.origin: 先生とか相談できるひとはいませんか？
dialogue.content: Is there a teacher or someone else you can talk to?

dialogue.origin: 今日は聴いてくれて
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening today…

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、、また話したいときはいつでも来てほしいです
dialogue.content: Thank you, too. Please come back anytime you want to talk.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 居場所が見つかるまで、ここが居場所になればいいなと思います
dialogue.content: Until you find a place where you belong, I hope this can be that place for you.

dialogue.origin: お時間になってしまいましたまた話しましょうね終了のメッセージが流れます
dialogue.content: It looks like our time is up. Let's talk again. A message will now play to end the session.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。お時間おくれまして申し訳ありません。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I apologize for running over time.)
